result.topic_en: Scattered calculations: the fifth power of a polynomial in ε written with coefficients A–E, power series with exponents (2^5, 3^5, 32, 243), and trigonometric parametrizations of a, b by r and φ related to the arithmetic-geometric mean step a'=(a+b)/2, b'=√(a'b).

methods.what: Fifth power of a quartic polynomial in ε expressed with new coefficients A, B, C, D, E
Parametrization a=r sin φ, b=r tan φ giving a/b=cos φ and r in terms of a, b
Half-angle relation from a/b = cos φ
Arithmetic mean of a=r/sin φ, b=r/tan φ via half-angle cotangent
Mean iteration step (Borchardt/Schwab type: a'=(a+b)/2, b'=√(a'b)) with a=r/tan φ, b=r/sin φ, halving the angle
